Current project · in development

Singular

A top-down action roguelike in pixel art. Blood is your only resource: you heal and reload by bathing in what you spill. Doubt gets you killed. And it is the only way to break the loop.

Aggressive combatPersistent bossesNarrative in motionHandcrafted pixel art

The corporation is fictional. The game is not.

Iterum Corporation is an independent Spanish studio operating under the guise of a corporation that does not exist.

It has no headquarters, no board, no shareholders. It has a deliberately small team that decided the best way to make a dense, replayable game is to pretend to be an enormous organisation. The emblem, a serpent biting its own tail, run through by a sword, is taken seriously. The rest, as convenient.

Singular was born from a sudden stop and a question: where am I, and where am I going? It speaks of technology and what it does to us, of the purpose many of us cannot find, and of a time that no longer feels like ours. We could have written a book. We would rather give the player the chance to defeat the serpent themselves.

Purpose · why Iterum exists

Disconnect to reconnect.

We make technology, and we know what technology does to time, to attention, and to the people next to us. We use it with intent: games that end, that get talked about with others, and that leave a question instead of a notification.
